front.en: Starting and ending landmarks of true leg length?
front.ur: True leg length ke starting aur ending landmarks?

back.en: ASIS to the tip of the medial malleolus (across the inner side of the knee).
back.ur: ASIS se medial malleolus ki nok tak (knee ki andar wali side se).

lessonTitle: Limb Length and Girth — True, Apparent and Functional Leg Length, Swelling and Wasting

front.en: Equal true length but unequal apparent length means?
front.ur: Barabar true length lekin na-barabar apparent length ka matlab?

back.en: A functional discrepancy: pelvic obliquity or a hip adduction/abduction contracture.
back.ur: Functional discrepancy: pelvic obliquity ya hip adduction/abduction contracture.

lessonTitle: Limb Length and Girth — True, Apparent and Functional Leg Length, Swelling and Wasting

front.en: Where do you measure thigh girth?
front.ur: Thigh girth kahan naapte hain?

back.en: 10 cm above the upper pole of the patella, the same level on both sides.
back.ur: Patella ke upper pole se 10 cm upar, dono sides par wohi level.

lessonTitle: Limb Length and Girth — True, Apparent and Functional Leg Length, Swelling and Wasting

front.en: What does a Galeazzi test with one lower knee show?
front.ur: Ek neechay knee wala Galeazzi test kya dikhata hai?

back.en: A shorter tibia on that side (further-back knee = shorter femur).
back.ur: Us side ka tibia chhota (peechay wala knee = chhota femur).

lessonTitle: Spinal Mobility and General Measures — Schober, Chest Expansion, Occiput-Wall, Grip and BMI

front.en: Normal modified Schober result?
front.ur: Normal modified Schober result?

back.en: 15 cm growing to at least 20 cm (an increase of 5 cm or more).
back.ur: 15 cm barh kar kam az kam 20 cm (5 cm ya zyada izafa).

lessonTitle: Spinal Mobility and General Measures — Schober, Chest Expansion, Occiput-Wall, Grip and BMI

front.en: Normal chest expansion and where is it measured?
front.ur: Normal chest expansion aur kahan naapi jati hai?

back.en: At least 2.5 cm (often 4–5 cm) at the 4th intercostal space (nipple line).
back.ur: Kam az kam 2.5 cm (aksar 4–5 cm), 4th intercostal space (nipple line) par.

lessonTitle: Spinal Mobility and General Measures — Schober, Chest Expansion, Occiput-Wall, Grip and BMI

front.en: Low grip strength cut-offs (EWGSOP2)?
front.ur: Low grip strength cut-offs (EWGSOP2)?

back.en: Under 27 kg in men and under 16 kg in women.
back.ur: Mardon mein 27 kg se kam aur aurton mein 16 kg se kam.

lessonTitle: Spinal Mobility and General Measures — Schober, Chest Expansion, Occiput-Wall, Grip and BMI

front.en: What is the normal occiput-to-wall distance?
front.ur: Normal occiput-to-wall distance?

back.en: 0 cm (above about 2 cm suggests thoracic kyphosis or spondylitis).
back.ur: 0 cm (takriban 2 cm se zyada thoracic kyphosis ya spondylitis batata hai).

lessonTitle: Posture Analysis with a Plumb Line — Front, Back and Side

front.en: Plumb-line landmarks in side view?
front.ur: Side view mein plumb-line landmarks?

back.en: Ear, shoulder (acromion), greater trochanter, just in front of the knee centre and just in front of the lateral malleolus.
back.ur: Kaan, shoulder (acromion), greater trochanter, knee ke beech ke aur lateral malleolus ke bilkul samne.

lessonTitle: Posture Analysis with a Plumb Line — Front, Back and Side

front.en: How do you tell functional from structural posture?
front.ur: Functional ko structural posture se kaise alag karte hain?

back.en: A functional deviation corrects when the patient changes position; a structural one persists.
back.ur: Functional deviation position badalne par theek ho jati hai; structural rehti hai.

lessonTitle: Posture Analysis with a Plumb Line — Front, Back and Side

front.en: Which measure tracks forward head posture?
front.ur: Forward head posture kis measure se track hoti hai?

back.en: Craniovertebral angle from a standardised photograph (and occiput-to-wall distance).
back.ur: Standardised photograph se craniovertebral angle (aur occiput-to-wall distance).

lessonTitle: Posture Analysis with a Plumb Line — Front, Back and Side

front.en: Is posture strongly linked to pain?
front.ur: Kya posture dard se mazboot taur par jura hai?

back.en: No: only a weak association; treat posture when it relates to the patient's symptoms or function.
back.ur: Nahi: sirf kamzor taluq; posture ka ilaaj tab karein jab woh patient ke symptoms ya function se jura ho.

lessonTitle: Janda's Crossed Syndromes and Kendall's Postures — Tight, Weak and What To Do

front.en: Which muscles are tight in the upper crossed syndrome?
front.ur: Upper crossed syndrome mein kaun se muscles tight hain?

back.en: Upper trapezius, levator scapulae, pectoralis major and minor (and sternocleidomastoid).
back.ur: Upper trapezius, levator scapulae, pectoralis major aur minor (aur sternocleidomastoid).

lessonTitle: Janda's Crossed Syndromes and Kendall's Postures — Tight, Weak and What To Do

front.en: Which muscles are weak in the lower crossed syndrome?
front.ur: Lower crossed syndrome mein kaun se muscles kamzor hain?

back.en: Abdominals and gluteus maximus and medius.
back.ur: Abdominals aur gluteus maximus aur medius.

lessonTitle: Janda's Crossed Syndromes and Kendall's Postures — Tight, Weak and What To Do

front.en: How does sway-back posture differ from kypho-lordotic?
front.ur: Sway-back posture kypho-lordotic se kaise mukhtalif hai?

back.en: Sway-back: pelvis forward and tilted back, trunk leaning back, strong short hamstrings; kypho-lordotic: anterior pelvic tilt with tight hip flexors.
back.ur: Sway-back: pelvis aage aur peechay tilted, trunk peechay, mazboot chhote hamstrings; kypho-lordotic: tight hip flexors ke saath anterior pelvic tilt.

lessonTitle: Janda's Crossed Syndromes and Kendall's Postures — Tight, Weak and What To Do

front.en: How good is the evidence for the crossed-syndrome model?
front.ur: Crossed-syndrome model ka evidence kitna acha hai?

back.en: Weak and inconsistent: use it as a hypothesis and treat measurable findings.
back.ur: Kamzor aur be-tarteeb: isay hypothesis ki tarah use karein aur naapi ja sakne wali findings ka ilaaj karein.

lessonTitle: Scoliosis Screening and Limb Alignment — Adams Test, Knees and Feet

front.en: What is the Adams forward-bend test for?
front.ur: Adams forward-bend test kis liye hai?

back.en: Screening for structural scoliosis: a rib hump or scoliometer trunk rotation of about 5–7° or more.
back.ur: Structural scoliosis ki screening: rib hump ya takriban 5–7° ya zyada scoliometer trunk rotation.

lessonTitle: Scoliosis Screening and Limb Alignment — Adams Test, Knees and Feet

front.en: When are knock knees normal?
front.ur: Knock knees kab normal hain?

back.en: At about 3–6 years, correcting with growth.
back.ur: Takriban 3–6 saal mein, barhne ke saath theek hote hue.

lessonTitle: Scoliosis Screening and Limb Alignment — Adams Test, Knees and Feet

front.en: What distinguishes flexible from rigid flat foot?
front.ur: Flexible aur rigid flat foot mein kya farq hai?

back.en: The arch re-forms on tiptoe (or big-toe extension) in a flexible foot; it does not in a rigid one.
back.ur: Flexible foot mein tiptoe (ya big-toe extension) par arch dobara banti hai; rigid mein nahi.

lessonTitle: Scoliosis Screening and Limb Alignment — Adams Test, Knees and Feet

front.en: A cavus foot with claw toes and reduced ankle jerks suggests?
front.ur: Cavus foot, claw toes aur kam ankle jerks kya batate hain?

back.en: A neurological cause such as Charcot–Marie–Tooth disease.
back.ur: Neurological wajah jaise Charcot–Marie–Tooth disease.

lessonTitle: Palpation of Spinal Levels — C7, T3, T7, L4 and S2

front.en: Levels of the scapular spine root, inferior angle and iliac crests?
front.ur: Scapular spine root, inferior angle aur iliac crests ke levels?

back.en: T3, T7 and L4 (Tuffier's line).
back.ur: T3, T7 aur L4 (Tuffier's line).

lessonTitle: Palpation of Spinal Levels — C7, T3, T7, L4 and S2

front.en: What level is the PSIS?
front.ur: PSIS kaun sa level hai?

lessonTitle: Palpation of Spinal Levels — C7, T3, T7, L4 and S2

front.en: How do you identify C7?
front.ur: C7 kaise pehchante hain?

back.en: The prominent bump at the base of the neck; on neck extension C6 glides forward and disappears, C7 stays.
back.ur: Gardan ke base par numaya bump; neck extension par C6 aage slide kar ke ghayab ho jata hai, C7 rehta hai.

lessonTitle: Palpation of Spinal Levels — C7, T3, T7, L4 and S2

front.en: How accurate is spinal level palpation?
front.ur: Spinal level palpation kitni accurate hai?

back.en: Often one level out; use several landmarks and document as approximate.
back.ur: Aksar ek level ghalat; kayi landmarks use karein aur takreeban likhein.

lessonTitle: Palpation of the Chest, Shoulder and Elbow — From the Jugular Notch to the Epicondyles

front.en: Where do you find the sternal angle?
front.ur: Sternal angle kahan milta hai?

back.en: About 5 cm below the jugular notch as a horizontal ridge; the 2nd rib joins here (level with T4–T5).
back.ur: Jugular notch se takriban 5 cm neeche horizontal ridge; yahan 2nd rib judti hai (T4–T5 ke barabar).

lessonTitle: Palpation of the Chest, Shoulder and Elbow — From the Jugular Notch to the Epicondyles

front.en: What is tender over the lateral epicondyle in tennis elbow?
front.ur: Tennis elbow mein lateral epicondyle par kya tender hota hai?

back.en: The common extensor tendon origin.
back.ur: Common extensor tendon ka origin.

lessonTitle: Palpation of the Chest, Shoulder and Elbow — From the Jugular Notch to the Epicondyles

front.en: Which nerve lies behind the medial epicondyle?
front.ur: Medial epicondyle ke peechay kaun si nerve hoti hai?

back.en: The ulnar nerve ("funny bone").
back.ur: Ulnar nerve (“funny bone”).

lessonTitle: Palpation of the Chest, Shoulder and Elbow — From the Jugular Notch to the Epicondyles

front.en: What does a step at the AC joint suggest?
front.ur: AC joint par step kya batata hai?

back.en: An AC joint sprain or separation.
back.ur: AC joint sprain ya separation.

lessonTitle: Palpation of the Hip, Knee and Ankle — Pulses, Landmarks and the Ottawa Rules

front.en: What are the Ottawa ankle rule triggers for X-ray?
front.ur: X-ray ke liye Ottawa ankle rule ke triggers?

back.en: Bone tenderness at the posterior edge or tip of either malleolus (distal 6 cm), or inability to bear weight for 4 steps.
back.ur: Dono malleoli ke peechle kinare ya nok par (distal 6 cm) bony tenderness, ya 4 qadam wazan na utha sakna.

lessonTitle: Palpation of the Hip, Knee and Ankle — Pulses, Landmarks and the Ottawa Rules

front.en: What are the foot series landmarks?
front.ur: Foot series ke landmarks?

back.en: The base of the 5th metatarsal and the navicular.
back.ur: 5th metatarsal ka base aur navicular.

lessonTitle: Palpation of the Hip, Knee and Ankle — Pulses, Landmarks and the Ottawa Rules

front.en: How common is an absent dorsalis pedis pulse?
front.ur: Dorsalis pedis pulse ka gayab hona kitna aam hai?

back.en: About 10% of healthy people; check the posterior tibial pulse too.
back.ur: Takriban 10 % healthy log; posterior tibial pulse bhi check karein.

lessonTitle: Palpation of the Hip, Knee and Ankle — Pulses, Landmarks and the Ottawa Rules

front.en: Why is the fibular head important to palpate?
front.ur: Fibular head palpate karna kyun ahem hai?

back.en: It is a landmark for the knee Ottawa rule and the common fibular nerve winds just below it.
back.ur: Yeh knee Ottawa rule ka landmark hai aur common fibular nerve iske bilkul neeche lipti hai.

lessonTitle: Pulse, Blood Pressure and Respiratory Rate — Getting Them Right Every Time

front.en: Normal adult resting pulse, BP and respiratory rate?
front.ur: Normal adult aaraam ki pulse, BP aur respiratory rate?

back.en: 60–100 bpm, about 120/80 mmHg and 12–20 breaths per minute.
back.ur: 60–100 bpm, takriban 120/80 mmHg aur 12–20 breaths per minute.

lessonTitle: Pulse, Blood Pressure and Respiratory Rate — Getting Them Right Every Time

front.en: How fast should you deflate the cuff?
front.ur: Cuff kitni tezi se deflate karein?

back.en: 2–3 mmHg per second; first sound is systolic, sounds disappearing is diastolic.
back.ur: 2–3 mmHg per second; pehli awaz systolic, awaz ka ghayab hona diastolic.

lessonTitle: Pulse, Blood Pressure and Respiratory Rate — Getting Them Right Every Time

front.en: How big should the cuff bladder be?
front.ur: Cuff ka bladder kitna bara ho?

back.en: About 80% of the arm circumference; too small reads falsely high.
back.ur: Arm ki circumference ka takriban 80 %; chhoti cuff jhooti zyada reading deti hai.

lessonTitle: Pulse, Blood Pressure and Respiratory Rate — Getting Them Right Every Time

front.en: Why count respiration without telling the patient?
front.ur: Patient ko batae bagair respiration kyun ginte hain?

back.en: Awareness changes breathing; keep your fingers on the wrist as if still taking the pulse.
back.ur: Agahi saans ko badal deti hai; ungliyan wrist par aise rakhein jaise pulse le rahe hon.

lessonTitle: SpO₂, Temperature and Capillary Refill — Reading the Small Numbers Safely

front.en: When do you stop exercise based on SpO₂?
front.ur: SpO₂ ki bunyad par exercise kab rokte hain?

back.en: Below about 88–90 % (or the prescribed target), especially with symptoms.
back.ur: Takriban 88–90 % (ya prescribed target) se neeche, khaas taur par symptoms ke saath.

lessonTitle: SpO₂, Temperature and Capillary Refill — Reading the Small Numbers Safely

front.en: Normal capillary refill time?
front.ur: Normal capillary refill time?

back.en: Under 2 seconds after pressing the nail bed for 5 seconds.
back.ur: Nail bed ko 5 seconds dabane ke baad 2 seconds se kam.

lessonTitle: SpO₂, Temperature and Capillary Refill — Reading the Small Numbers Safely

front.en: Normal body temperature range and fever threshold?
front.ur: Jism ke temperature ki normal range aur bukhar ki hadd?

back.en: About 36.1–37.2 °C; fever from 38 °C; hypothermia below 35 °C.
back.ur: Takriban 36.1–37.2 °C; bukhar 38 °C se; 35 °C se neeche hypothermia.

lessonTitle: SpO₂, Temperature and Capillary Refill — Reading the Small Numbers Safely

front.en: Two things that give a falsely low oximeter reading?
front.ur: Oximeter ki jhooti kam reading ki do wajahein?

back.en: Cold hands or poor perfusion, and movement (also nail varnish).
back.ur: Thande haath ya kharab perfusion, aur harkat (nail varnish bhi).

lessonTitle: Exercise Intensity — Borg RPE, Breathlessness Scale, Talk Test and Heart-Rate Reserve

front.en: Borg RPE target for most patients?
front.ur: Zyada tar patients ke liye Borg RPE target?

back.en: 11–14 (light to somewhat hard).
back.ur: 11–14 (light se somewhat hard).

lessonTitle: Exercise Intensity — Borg RPE, Breathlessness Scale, Talk Test and Heart-Rate Reserve

front.en: Karvonen formula?
front.ur: Karvonen formula?

back.en: Target HR = (HRmax − HRrest) × % + HRrest.
back.ur: Target HR = (HRmax − HRrest) × % + HRrest.

lessonTitle: Exercise Intensity — Borg RPE, Breathlessness Scale, Talk Test and Heart-Rate Reserve

front.en: What does the talk test say about moderate intensity?
front.ur: Moderate intensity ke baare mein talk test kya kehta hai?

back.en: You can talk but not sing, in short sentences.
back.ur: Aap baat kar sakte hain lekin gaa nahi sakte, chhote jumlay.

lessonTitle: Exercise Intensity — Borg RPE, Breathlessness Scale, Talk Test and Heart-Rate Reserve

front.en: When should you stop for breathlessness on CR10?
front.ur: CR10 par saans ke liye kab rokna chahiye?

back.en: At 7 or more, or if breathlessness is out of proportion to the work.
back.ur: 7 ya zyada par, ya jab saans kaam ke mutabiq na ho.

lessonTitle: Orthostatic Hypotension — Screening Before You Stand a Patient Up

front.en: Diagnostic criteria for orthostatic hypotension?
front.ur: Orthostatic hypotension ke diagnostic criteria?

back.en: A fall of at least 20 mmHg systolic or 10 mmHg diastolic within 3 minutes of standing (or symptoms).
back.ur: Khare hone ke 3 minute ke andar kam az kam 20 mmHg systolic ya 10 mmHg diastolic ki girawat (ya symptoms).

lessonTitle: Orthostatic Hypotension — Screening Before You Stand a Patient Up

front.en: When do you measure after standing?
front.ur: Khare hone ke baad kab naapte hain?

back.en: At 1 and 3 minutes (after 5 minutes of rest lying or seated).
back.ur: 1 aur 3 minute par (5 minute lete ya baithe rest ke baad).

lessonTitle: Orthostatic Hypotension — Screening Before You Stand a Patient Up

front.en: A flat heart-rate response to a big pressure fall suggests?
front.ur: Bari pressure girawat par flat heart-rate response kya batata hai?

back.en: A neurogenic (autonomic) cause rather than volume depletion.
back.ur: Volume ki kami ke bajaye neurogenic (autonomic) wajah.

lessonTitle: Orthostatic Hypotension — Screening Before You Stand a Patient Up

front.en: Two safe-standing strategies?
front.ur: Mehfooz khare hone ki do hikmat-e-amliyan?

back.en: Staged position changes (sit first) and ankle pumps or muscle tensing before standing.
back.ur: Marhala-war position tabdeeli (pehle baithna) aur khare hone se pehle ankle pumps ya muscle tensing.

lessonTitle: ABPI and Blood Glucose — Two Checks That Make Exercise Safer

front.en: How is the ABPI calculated and what are the cut-offs?
front.ur: ABPI kaise calculate hota hai aur cut-offs kya hain?

back.en: Ankle systolic ÷ higher arm systolic; 1.0–1.3 normal, below 0.9 disease, above 1.3 stiff vessels.
back.ur: Ankle systolic ÷ arm ka zyada systolic; 1.0–1.3 normal, 0.9 se kam bimari, 1.3 se zyada sakht vessels.

lessonTitle: ABPI and Blood Glucose — Two Checks That Make Exercise Safer

front.en: Where do you prick for a glucose reading?
front.ur: Glucose ke liye kahan prick karte hain?

back.en: The side of a fingertip, not the pad.
back.ur: Fingertip ki side, pad nahi.

lessonTitle: ABPI and Blood Glucose — Two Checks That Make Exercise Safer

front.en: Safe glucose range to start exercise?
front.ur: Exercise shuru karne ke liye mehfooz glucose range?

back.en: About 5.6–13.9 mmol/L (100–250 mg/dL); below 4 treat first; above about 15 check ketones.
back.ur: Takriban 5.6–13.9 mmol/L (100–250 mg/dL); 4 se kam pehle ilaaj; takriban 15 se upar ketones check karein.

lessonTitle: ABPI and Blood Glucose — Two Checks That Make Exercise Safer

front.en: Best exercise for claudication?
front.ur: Claudication ke liye behtareen exercise?

back.en: Supervised walking to moderate-to-severe calf pain, rest, repeat; at least 30–60 minutes three times weekly.
back.ur: Moderate se shadeed pindli ke dard tak supervised walking, rest, dohrayein; kam az kam 30–60 minute hafte mein teen baar.

lessonTitle: When to Stop — Exercise Stop Signs and Early Mobilisation on the Ward and ICU

front.en: List four stop signs for exercise.
front.ur: Exercise ke chaar stop signs ginwayein.

back.en: Chest pain, dizziness or pallor, severe breathlessness, falling systolic pressure or SpO₂ below about 88–90 %, or the patient asks to stop.
back.ur: Seene ka dard, chakkar ya pallor, shadeed saans ki takleef, girta systolic pressure ya SpO₂ takriban 88–90 % se neeche, ya patient rokne ko kahe.

lessonTitle: When to Stop — Exercise Stop Signs and Early Mobilisation on the Ward and ICU

front.en: Typical safe ranges for mobilising on ICU?
front.ur: ICU mein mobilise karne ki aam mehfooz ranges?

back.en: Heart rate about 40–130, MAP 60–110, SpO₂ ≥ 88–90 %, respiratory rate under about 30–35 (follow local protocol).
back.ur: Heart rate takriban 40–130, MAP 60–110, SpO₂ ≥ 88–90 %, respiratory rate takriban 30–35 se kam (local protocol follow karein).

lessonTitle: When to Stop — Exercise Stop Signs and Early Mobilisation on the Ward and ICU

front.en: What does NEWS2 combine?
front.ur: NEWS2 kya kya milata hai?

back.en: Respiratory rate, SpO₂, systolic BP, pulse, temperature and level of consciousness into one early-warning score.
back.ur: Respiratory rate, SpO₂, systolic BP, pulse, temperature aur hoshyari ki satah ek early-warning score mein.

lessonTitle: When to Stop — Exercise Stop Signs and Early Mobilisation on the Ward and ICU

front.en: What should you record after a session that stopped early?
front.ur: Jaldi ruk gayi session ke baad kya likhein?

back.en: The stage reached, the observations, the assistance needed and the reason for the stop.
back.ur: Pohnchne wala marhala, observations, darkaar madad aur rukne ki wajah.

lessonTitle: Timed Up and Go and Gait Speed — Two Minutes That Predict a Lot

front.en: TUG cut-offs for falls risk?
front.ur: TUG ke girne ke khatray ke cut-offs?

back.en: 12 s or more (CDC STEADI); 14 s or more is a stronger warning in older adults.
back.ur: 12 s ya zyada (CDC STEADI); buzurgon mein 14 s ya zyada sakht warning.

lessonTitle: Timed Up and Go and Gait Speed — Two Minutes That Predict a Lot

front.en: How is gait speed measured?
front.ur: Gait speed kaise naapi jati hai?

back.en: 10 m walkway, time only the middle 6 m; speed = distance ÷ time.
back.ur: 10 m walkway, sirf beech ke 6 m ka waqt; speed = faasla ÷ waqt.

lessonTitle: Timed Up and Go and Gait Speed — Two Minutes That Predict a Lot

front.en: Clinically meaningful change in gait speed?
front.ur: Gait speed mein clinically ahem tabdeeli?

back.en: About 0.1 m/s (small meaningful change about 0.05 m/s).
back.ur: Takriban 0.1 m/s (chhoti ahem tabdeeli takriban 0.05 m/s).

lessonTitle: Timed Up and Go and Gait Speed — Two Minutes That Predict a Lot

front.en: Gait speed needed to cross a street safely?
front.ur: Sarak safely paar karne ke liye gait speed?

back.en: About 1.2 m/s.
back.ur: Takriban 1.2 m/s.

lessonTitle: Sit-to-Stand Tests — 5×STS and the 30-Second Chair Stand

front.en: 5×STS cut-off for recurrent falls?
front.ur: 5×STS ka baar baar girne ka cut-off?

back.en: Over 15 seconds.
back.ur: 15 seconds se zyada.

lessonTitle: Sit-to-Stand Tests — 5×STS and the 30-Second Chair Stand

front.en: What is the 30-second chair stand?
front.ur: 30-second chair stand kya hai?

back.en: The number of full sit-to-stands in 30 seconds with arms folded; compare with age norms.
back.ur: Arms fold ke saath 30 seconds mein poore sit-to-stands ki ginti; umar ke norms se compare karein.

lessonTitle: Sit-to-Stand Tests — 5×STS and the 30-Second Chair Stand

front.en: Standard chair height for the tests?
front.ur: Tests ke liye standard chair ki unchai?

back.en: About 43 cm (43–46 cm), against a wall.
back.ur: Takriban 43 cm (43–46 cm), deewar ke saath.

lessonTitle: Sit-to-Stand Tests — 5×STS and the 30-Second Chair Stand

front.en: What do you do when the hands are used to push up?
front.ur: Haath dhakelne ke liye use hon to kya karte hain?

back.en: Stop and restart, or record that the test could not be completed unaided.
back.ur: Ruk kar dobara shuru karein, ya likhein ke test bina madad ke mukammal nahi hua.

lessonTitle: Choosing a Balance Test — Berg, FGA, Mini-BESTest, Four Square Step and mCTSIB

front.en: Berg Balance Scale: range and cut-off?
front.ur: Berg Balance Scale: range aur cut-off?

back.en: 0–56; below about 45 predicts falls; ceiling effect in active adults.
back.ur: 0–56; takriban 45 se neeche girna; active adults mein ceiling effect.

lessonTitle: Choosing a Balance Test — Berg, FGA, Mini-BESTest, Four Square Step and mCTSIB

front.en: What is special about the Mini-BESTest?
front.ur: Mini-BESTest mein khaas baat kya hai?

back.en: Four sections (anticipatory, reactive, sensory orientation, dynamic gait) show which system fails; about 19/28 or less flags falls risk.
back.ur: Chaar sections (anticipatory, reactive, sensory orientation, dynamic gait) batate hain ke kaun sa system fail hai; takriban 19/28 ya kam girne ka khatra.

lessonTitle: Choosing a Balance Test — Berg, FGA, Mini-BESTest, Four Square Step and mCTSIB

front.en: mCTSIB conditions?
front.ur: mCTSIB ki conditions?

back.en: Firm eyes open, firm eyes closed, foam eyes open, foam eyes closed (30 s each).
back.ur: Firm aankhein khuli, firm aankhein band, foam aankhein khuli, foam aankhein band (har ek 30 s).

lessonTitle: Choosing a Balance Test — Berg, FGA, Mini-BESTest, Four Square Step and mCTSIB

front.en: FSST cut-off?
front.ur: FSST ka cut-off?

back.en: 15 s or more suggests multiple-fall risk in older adults.
back.ur: 15 s ya zyada buzurgon mein kayi baar girne ka khatra.

lessonTitle: Brown-Séquard and the Cord Syndromes: Which Side Is Weak, Which Side Is Numb?

front.en: Which tract crosses in the medulla, and which crosses within the cord?
front.ur: Kaunsa tract medulla mein cross hota hai aur kaunsa cord ke andar?

back.en: Corticospinal crosses in the medulla; the spinothalamic crosses within one or two cord segments of entry. The dorsal columns cross in the medulla.
back.ur: Corticospinal medulla mein cross hota hai; spinothalamic dakhil hone ke ek do cord segments ke andar. Dorsal columns medulla mein cross hotay hain.

lessonTitle: Brown-Séquard and the Cord Syndromes: Which Side Is Weak, Which Side Is Numb?

front.en: What is Brown-Séquard syndrome?
front.ur: Brown-Séquard syndrome kya hai?

back.en: A half-cut cord: SAME-side weakness and lost position sense, OPPOSITE-side lost pain and temperature, starting a few segments below.
back.ur: Aadha kata cord: SAME side kamzori aur position sense ghayab, ULTI side dard aur temperature ghayab, kuch segments neeche se shuru.

lessonTitle: Brown-Séquard and the Cord Syndromes: Which Side Is Weak, Which Side Is Numb?

front.en: Which cord syndrome spares position sense but loses pain and strength?
front.ur: Kaunsa cord syndrome position sense bachata hai magar dard aur taqat ghayab karta hai?

back.en: Anterior cord syndrome: the dorsal columns have a separate blood supply, so they are spared.
back.ur: Anterior cord syndrome: dorsal columns ko alag khoon ki supply hoti hai, is liye woh bach jate hain.

lessonTitle: Brown-Séquard and the Cord Syndromes: Which Side Is Weak, Which Side Is Numb?

front.en: Which cord syndrome affects the arms more than the legs?
front.ur: Kaunsa cord syndrome bazooon ko taangon se zyada mutasir karta hai?

back.en: Central cord syndrome, typically an older person falling with a hyperextended, spondylotic neck.
back.ur: Central cord syndrome, aam taur par spondylotic gardan wala buzurg jo gardan ke hyperextend hone ke saath girta hai.

lessonTitle: Brown-Séquard and the Cord Syndromes: Which Side Is Weak, Which Side Is Numb?

front.en: What is autonomic dysreflexia and the first response?
front.ur: Autonomic dysreflexia kya hai aur pehla jawab?

back.en: A sudden blood-pressure surge in a cord injury at T6 or above (headache, flushing). Sit the patient up, loosen clothing, remove the trigger and call for help.
back.ur: T6 ya upar cord injury mein blood pressure ka achanak barhna (sar dard, chehra laal). Mareez ko baithayein, kapray dheelay karein, trigger door karein aur madad bulayein.

lessonTitle: Stroke Syndromes: Read the Artery from the Body

front.en: What does an MCA stroke typically cause?
front.ur: MCA stroke aam taur par kya karta hai?

back.en: Opposite face and arm weakness (more than the leg), sensory loss, hemianopia; aphasia if left, neglect if right.
back.ur: Ulti side chehra aur bazoo ki kamzori (taang se zyada), sensory kami, hemianopia; left mein aphasia, right mein neglect.

lessonTitle: Stroke Syndromes: Read the Artery from the Body

front.en: What does an ACA stroke typically cause?
front.ur: ACA stroke aam taur par kya karta hai?

back.en: Opposite leg weakness greater than the arm, apathy or abulia, urinary incontinence.
back.ur: Ulti taang ki kamzori bazoo se zyada, bedili ya abulia, peshab ka na rukna.

lessonTitle: Stroke Syndromes: Read the Artery from the Body

front.en: What does a PCA stroke typically cause?
front.ur: PCA stroke aam taur par kya karta hai?

back.en: Opposite homonymous hemianopia, possible thalamic sensory loss or pain; strength usually spared.
back.ur: Ulti homonymous hemianopia, mumkin thalamic sensory kami ya dard; taqat aksar bachi rehti hai.

lessonTitle: Stroke Syndromes: Read the Artery from the Body

front.en: What is the lateral medullary (Wallenberg) pattern?
front.ur: Lateral medullary (Wallenberg) pattern kya hai?

back.en: Vertigo, dysphagia, same-side Horner's and face pain/temperature loss, opposite-side body pain/temperature loss.
back.ur: Chakkar, dysphagia, usi side Horner's aur chehre ke dard/temperature ki kami, ulti side jism ke dard/temperature ki kami.

lessonTitle: Stroke Syndromes: Read the Artery from the Body

front.en: What does BE-FAST stand for?
front.ur: BE-FAST ka matlab kya hai?

back.en: Balance, Eyes, Face, Arm, Speech, Time: any sudden sign means call emergency help now.
back.ur: Balance, Eyes, Face, Arm, Speech, Time: koi achanak alamat ho to foran emergency madad bulayein.

lessonTitle: BPPV: Dix-Hallpike, the Epley Manoeuvre and When Not to Treat

front.en: What is BPPV?
front.ur: BPPV kya hai?

back.en: Loose otoconia (calcium crystals) in a semicircular canal, usually the posterior one, causing brief position-triggered vertigo.
back.ur: Semicircular canal (aam taur par posterior) mein dheelay otoconia (calcium crystals), jo mukhtasar position se trigger hone wala chakkar deta hain.

lessonTitle: BPPV: Dix-Hallpike, the Epley Manoeuvre and When Not to Treat

front.en: What is a positive Dix-Hallpike for the posterior canal?
front.ur: Posterior canal ke liye positive Dix-Hallpike kya hai?

back.en: Vertigo plus upbeating-torsional nystagmus after a short delay, lasting under a minute and fatiguing on repetition.
back.ur: Chakkar aur thori der baad upar jhatka aur ghoomta nystagmus, ek minute se kam, dohrane par thak jata hai.

lessonTitle: BPPV: Dix-Hallpike, the Epley Manoeuvre and When Not to Treat

front.en: Give the five steps of the Epley manoeuvre.
front.ur: Epley manoeuvre ke paanch qadam batayein.

back.en: Sit with the head 45° to the affected side; lie back head-hanging; turn the head 90° to the other side; roll the body to nose-down 45°; sit up. Hold each 30–60 s.
back.ur: Mutasir side par sar 45° ke saath baithein; sar latka kar litayein; sar 90° doosri side ghumayein; jism karwat se naak 45° neechay; uth baithein. Har position 30–60 s.

lessonTitle: BPPV: Dix-Hallpike, the Epley Manoeuvre and When Not to Treat

front.en: Which findings mean a central cause, not BPPV?
front.ur: Kaunsi findings central wajah dikhati hain, BPPV nahi?

back.en: Down-beating or direction-changing nystagmus, no delay, no fading, or new neurological signs or inability to walk.
back.ur: Neechay wala ya simt badalne wala nystagmus, delay nahi, khatam nahi hota, ya nayi neurological alamat ya chal na sakna.

lessonTitle: Spasticity or Contracture? The Tardieu Catch Lab

front.en: What is spasticity?
front.ur: Spasticity kya hai?

back.en: A velocity-dependent increase in the tonic stretch reflex (resistance rises with speed), part of the upper motor neuron syndrome.
back.ur: Tonic stretch reflex ka velocity-dependent izafa (raftaar ke saath muzahimat barhti hai), upper motor neuron syndrome ka hissa.

lessonTitle: Spasticity or Contracture? The Tardieu Catch Lab

front.en: What do R1 and R2 mean in the Tardieu method?
front.ur: Tardieu tareeqe mein R1 aur R2 ka kya matlab hai?

back.en: R1 = the angle of the catch at fast stretch; R2 = the full passive range at the slowest stretch. R2 − R1 is the neural component.
back.ur: R1 = tez stretch par catch ka angle; R2 = sab se aahista stretch par poori passive range. R2 − R1 neural hissa hai.

lessonTitle: Spasticity or Contracture? The Tardieu Catch Lab

front.en: How does rigidity differ from spasticity on a stretch test?
front.ur: Stretch test par rigidity spasticity se kaise alag hai?

back.en: Rigidity resists equally at all speeds with no catch; spasticity is velocity-dependent with a catch.
back.ur: Rigidity har raftaar par ek jaisi muzahimat karti hai aur catch nahi hota; spasticity velocity-dependent hai aur catch hota hai.

lessonTitle: Spasticity or Contracture? The Tardieu Catch Lab

front.en: What does a short R2 that does not change with speed suggest?
front.ur: Chhota R2 jo raftaar se nahi badalta, kya dikhata hai?

back.en: A fixed (non-neural) contracture: tissue shortening needing stretch, casting, orthoses or surgery.
back.ur: Fixed (non-neural) contracture: tissue ka chhota hona jis ke liye stretch, casting, orthoses ya surgery chahiye.

lessonTitle: Developmental Milestones 0 to 5 Years: What Is Typical, What Is a Flag

front.en: What does a milestone mean in the 2022 CDC checklists?
front.ur: 2022 CDC checklists mein milestone ka kya matlab hai?

back.en: A skill that at least 75% of children (three in four) show by that age.
back.ur: Aisa hunar jo us umar tak kam az kam 75% bachay (chaar mein se teen) dikhate hain.

lessonTitle: Developmental Milestones 0 to 5 Years: What Is Typical, What Is a Flag

front.en: How do you correct a premature baby's age?
front.ur: Qabl-az-waqt bachay ki umar kaise correct karte hain?

back.en: Calendar age minus the number of weeks (or months) born early, applied until 24 months.
back.ur: Calendar umar minus pehle paida hone ke hafte (ya mahine), 24 mahine tak lagayein.

lessonTitle: Developmental Milestones 0 to 5 Years: What Is Typical, What Is a Flag

front.en: Give three flags that need prompt referral.
front.ur: Teen flags batayein jin par jaldi referral chahiye.

back.en: Loss of a skill; strong hand preference before 12 months; not walking by 18 months (also no babbling by 12 months, abnormal tone).
back.ur: Hunar kho dena; 12 mahine se pehle ek haath ko majboot taraseeh; 18 mahine tak chalna nahi (saath 12 mahine tak babbling nahi, ghair-mamooli tone).

lessonTitle: Developmental Milestones 0 to 5 Years: What Is Typical, What Is a Flag

front.en: What did the WHO study show about walking age?
front.ur: WHO study ne chalne ki umar ke bare mein kya dikhaya?

back.en: Healthy children walked alone anywhere between about 8 and 18 months: the normal window is wide.
back.ur: Sehatmand bachay taqreeban 8 se 18 mahine ke beech kabhi bhi akelay chale: normal window wasee hai.

lessonTitle: Primitive Reflexes and Postural Reactions: The Hidden Timeline of Infant Movement

front.en: Name three primitive reflexes and when they fade.
front.ur: Teen primitive reflexes batayein aur woh kab khatam hotay hain.

back.en: Moro about 4 to 6 months; palmar grasp about 5 to 6 months; ATNR about 6 months (Babinski up to about 2 years).
back.ur: Moro taqreeban 4 se 6 mahine; palmar grasp taqreeban 5 se 6 mahine; ATNR taqreeban 6 mahine (Babinski taqreeban 2 saal tak).

lessonTitle: Primitive Reflexes and Postural Reactions: The Hidden Timeline of Infant Movement

front.en: When do the parachute reactions appear?
front.ur: Parachute reactions kab aati hain?

back.en: Forward about 6 months, sideways about 7, backward about 9; they stay for life.
back.ur: Forward taqreeban 6 mahine, sideways taqreeban 7, backward taqreeban 9; umar bhar rehti hain.

lessonTitle: Primitive Reflexes and Postural Reactions: The Hidden Timeline of Infant Movement

front.en: What is an obligatory reflex?
front.ur: Lazmi (obligatory) reflex kya hai?

back.en: A reflex so strong the child cannot move out of it, for example an ATNR that always pulls the arm out when the head turns; a red flag.
back.ur: Itna mazboot reflex ke bachcha us se nikal nahi sakta, maslan ATNR jo sar ghumne par hamesha bazoo phaila deta hai; red flag.

lessonTitle: Primitive Reflexes and Postural Reactions: The Hidden Timeline of Infant Movement

front.en: Why use the corrected age for reflexes?
front.ur: Reflexes ke liye corrected umar kyun?

back.en: A baby born early has had less time to mature, so judge reflexes by calendar age minus the weeks born early, until 24 months.
back.ur: Qabl-az-waqt paida bachay ko pukhta hone ka kam waqt mila, is liye reflexes ko 24 mahine tak calendar umar minus pehle paida hone ke hafte se parkhein.

lessonTitle: Cerebral Palsy and the GMFCS: Levels I to V, Hips and Goals

front.en: What is cerebral palsy?
front.ur: Cerebral palsy kya hai?

back.en: Permanent disorders of movement and posture from a non-progressive disturbance in the developing fetal or infant brain, often with other problems (sensation, cognition, epilepsy).
back.ur: Barhte hue janeen ya shireer dimagh mein ghair-progressive nuqsan se harkat aur posture ke mustaqil masail, aksar doosray masail (sensation, idrak, epilepsy) ke saath.

lessonTitle: Cerebral Palsy and the GMFCS: Levels I to V, Hips and Goals

front.en: What does the GMFCS classify?
front.ur: GMFCS kya classify karta hai?

back.en: The child's usual gross motor function (sitting, transfers, mobility) in five levels and five age bands.
back.ur: Bachay ka aam gross motor function (baithna, transfers, harkat) paanch levels aur paanch umar ke bandon mein.

lessonTitle: Cerebral Palsy and the GMFCS: Levels I to V, Hips and Goals

front.en: What separates Level II from Level III?
front.ur: Level II aur Level III mein kya farq hai?

back.en: Level III children need a handheld mobility device to walk and use wheeled mobility for distance; Level II walk without a device in most places.
back.ur: Level III bachon ko chalne ke liye haath ka mobility device chahiye aur faaslay ke liye wheeled mobility; Level II aksar jagah baghair device chalte hain.

lessonTitle: Cerebral Palsy and the GMFCS: Levels I to V, Hips and Goals

front.en: How does hip risk change with GMFCS level?
front.ur: GMFCS level ke saath hip risk kaise badalta hai?

back.en: About 0% at Level I, 15% at II, 41% at III, 69% at IV and 90% at V for migration over 30%.
back.ur: Migration 30% se zyada ke liye Level I par taqreeban 0%, II par 15%, III par 41%, IV par 69% aur V par 90%.

lessonTitle: Cerebral Palsy and the GMFCS: Levels I to V, Hips and Goals

front.en: What is the Reimers migration percentage?
front.ur: Reimers migration percentage kya hai?

back.en: The share of the femoral head lying outside the acetabulum on an AP pelvis X-ray; about 30% or more is considered at risk.
back.ur: AP pelvis X-ray par femoral head ka woh hissa jo acetabulum se bahar hai; taqreeban 30% ya zyada khatre mein samjha jata hai.

lessonTitle: Neck Manipulation Safety — Screening for Artery Problems Before You Treat

front.en: What is cervical arterial dysfunction?
front.ur: Cervical arterial dysfunction kya hai?

back.en: A problem of the vertebral or carotid arteries in the neck, such as a dissection, which can present as neck pain or headache.
back.ur: Gardan ki vertebral ya carotid arteries ka masla, maslan dissection, jo gardan ke dard ya sar dard ki tarah aa sakta hai.

lessonTitle: Neck Manipulation Safety — Screening for Artery Problems Before You Treat

front.en: What are the 5 Ds and 3 Ns?
front.ur: 5 Ds aur 3 Ns kya hain?

back.en: Dizziness, diplopia, dysarthria, dysphagia, drop attacks; nausea, numbness, nystagmus.
back.ur: Dizziness, diplopia, dysarthria, dysphagia, drop attacks; nausea, numbness, nystagmus.

lessonTitle: Neck Manipulation Safety — Screening for Artery Problems Before You Treat

front.en: Can a negative neck-rotation test clear the neck?
front.ur: Kya negative neck-rotation test gardan ko clear kar sakta hai?

back.en: No. These positional tests are not accurate enough; clinical reasoning decides.
back.ur: Nahi. Yeh positional tests kaafi durust nahi; faisla clinical reasoning karti hai.

lessonTitle: Neck Manipulation Safety — Screening for Artery Problems Before You Treat

front.en: What do you do if you suspect an artery dissection?
front.ur: Artery dissection ka shak ho to kya karein?

back.en: Do not treat the neck; arrange emergency medical care and keep the patient safe.
back.ur: Gardan ka ilaaj na karein; emergency medical care ka intezam karein aur patient ko mehfooz rakhein.

lessonTitle: Neural Mobilisation — Testing and Treating the Nerve as a Moving Structure

front.en: What is a neurodynamic test?
front.ur: Neurodynamic test kya hai?

back.en: A test that moves a limb to load a nerve and reproduce symptoms, such as the straight leg raise or slump test.
back.ur: Aisa test jo limb hila kar nerve par bojh daalta hai aur alamat dobara paida karta hai, maslan straight leg raise ya slump test.

lessonTitle: Neural Mobilisation — Testing and Treating the Nerve as a Moving Structure

front.en: What is structural differentiation?
front.ur: Structural differentiation kya hai?

back.en: Changing a movement far from the symptom to see whether the symptom changes, which points to the nerve.
back.ur: Alamat se door ki harkat badal kar dekhna ke alamat badli ya nahi, jo nerve ki taraf ishara karta hai.

lessonTitle: Neural Mobilisation — Testing and Treating the Nerve as a Moving Structure

front.en: Slider or tensioner for an irritable nerve?
front.ur: Irritable nerve ke liye slider ya tensioner?

back.en: A slider: it glides the nerve with low tension.
back.ur: Slider: yeh nerve ko kam tension se sarkata hai.

lessonTitle: Neural Mobilisation — Testing and Treating the Nerve as a Moving Structure

front.en: Which symptoms mean refer urgently?
front.ur: Kaun si alamat par fori refer karein?

back.en: Progressive weakness, foot drop, bladder or bowel changes, saddle numbness or numbness in both legs.
back.ur: Barhti kamzori, foot drop, peshab ya pakhane ki tabdeeli, saddle sunn hona ya dono taangon mein sunn hona.

lessonTitle: Muscle Energy Technique — Using the Patient's Own Contraction

front.en: What effort is used in a standard PIR contraction?
front.ur: Standard PIR contraction mein kitna effort hota hai?

back.en: A light effort, about 20% of maximum, held for 5 to 10 seconds.
back.ur: Halka effort, maximum ka takriban 20%, 5 se 10 second.

lessonTitle: Muscle Energy Technique — Using the Patient's Own Contraction

front.en: What is reciprocal inhibition in MET?
front.ur: MET mein reciprocal inhibition kya hai?

back.en: The patient contracts the opposite muscle (the antagonist), which is thought to calm the tight muscle so it lets go.
back.ur: Patient ulta muscle (antagonist) contract karta hai jisse tight muscle shaant hota mana jata hai.

lessonTitle: Muscle Energy Technique — Using the Patient's Own Contraction

front.en: How many repeats do you do?
front.ur: Kitni baar dohrate hain?

back.en: Three to five rounds, then retest the range; stop when the range stops improving.
back.ur: Teen se paanch round, phir range dobara test karein; jab range behtar hona band ho to ruk jayein.

lessonTitle: Muscle Energy Technique — Using the Patient's Own Contraction

front.en: Why can the range improve even if the muscle is not longer?
front.ur: Muscle lamba na ho tab bhi range kyun behtar hoti hai?

back.en: Mostly because of better stretch tolerance and less guarding, not a change in muscle length.
back.ur: Zyada tar behtar stretch tolerance aur kam guarding se, muscle ki lambai badalne se nahi.

lessonTitle: What Manual Therapy Really Does — And How to Explain It to Patients

front.en: What is the main route by which manual therapy relieves pain?
front.ur: Manual therapy dard kam karne ka zyada tar kaunsa raasta istemal karti hai?

back.en: Through the nervous system and context effects, not by repositioning bones.
back.ur: Nervous system aur context effects ke zariye, haddiyan jagah par rakh kar nahi.

lessonTitle: What Manual Therapy Really Does — And How to Explain It to Patients

front.en: What are context effects?
front.ur: Context effects kya hain?

back.en: The effects of expectation, trust, the setting and the words used on how treatment is experienced.
back.ur: Umeed, bharosa, mahaul aur alfaz ka ilaaj ke tajurbe par asar.

lessonTitle: What Manual Therapy Really Does — And How to Explain It to Patients

front.en: Why add an exercise straight after a technique?
front.ur: Technique ke foran baad exercise kyun?

back.en: Pain is lower and movement easier for a short time, so the gain can be held.
back.ur: Thori der dard kam aur harkat aasan hoti hai, is liye faida barqarar rakha ja sakta hai.

lessonTitle: What Manual Therapy Really Does — And How to Explain It to Patients

front.en: Give one phrase to avoid and one to use.
front.ur: Ek phrase jis se bachein aur ek jo istemal karein?

back.en: Avoid "your pelvis is out of place"; use "it is working stiffly and we will help it move".
back.ur: "Aap ka pelvis jagah se hata hua hai" se bachein; "yeh akarha chal raha hai aur hum madad karenge" istemal karein.

lessonTitle: Thoracic Spine Manipulation for Neck Pain — Choosing Thrust or Non-Thrust

front.en: Which part of the spine can be treated for neck pain?
front.ur: Gardan ke dard ke liye reerh ka kaunsa hissa treat ho sakta hai?

back.en: The upper thoracic spine, with thrust or non-thrust mobilisation.
back.ur: Upper thoracic spine, thrust ya non-thrust mobilisation se.

lessonTitle: Thoracic Spine Manipulation for Neck Pain — Choosing Thrust or Non-Thrust

front.en: When is non-thrust the better choice?
front.ur: Non-thrust kab behtar hai?

back.en: For an irritable, very painful or anxious patient, or when a thrust is not safe.
back.ur: Irritable, bohat dardnak ya pareshan patient ke liye, ya jab thrust mehfooz na ho.

lessonTitle: Thoracic Spine Manipulation for Neck Pain — Choosing Thrust or Non-Thrust

front.en: Name two reasons not to thrust.
front.ur: Thrust na karne ki do wajoohat batayein.

back.en: Fracture risk (osteoporosis, recent trauma) or a possible serious condition (tumour, infection, cord signs).
back.ur: Fracture ka khatra (osteoporosis, haal ki chot) ya mumkin serious bimari (tumour, infection, cord signs).

lessonTitle: Thoracic Spine Manipulation for Neck Pain — Choosing Thrust or Non-Thrust

front.en: What should follow the technique?
front.ur: Technique ke baad kya hona chahiye?

back.en: Re-testing of movement and pain, then an exercise to keep the change.
back.ur: Harkat aur dard ka dobara test, phir badlao barqarar rakhne ke liye exercise.

lessonTitle: Using Special Tests Wisely — Rule In, Rule Out and Clusters

front.en: What does SnNout mean?
front.ur: SnNout ka kya matlab hai?

back.en: A negative result on a highly sensitive test helps to rule the problem out.
back.ur: Bohat sensitive test par negative result masle ko rule out karne mein madad karta hai.

lessonTitle: Using Special Tests Wisely — Rule In, Rule Out and Clusters

front.en: What does SpPin mean?
front.ur: SpPin ka kya matlab hai?

back.en: A positive result on a highly specific test helps to rule the problem in.
back.ur: Bohat specific test par positive result masle ko rule in karne mein madad karta hai.

lessonTitle: Using Special Tests Wisely — Rule In, Rule Out and Clusters

front.en: Which likelihood ratios change the odds a lot?
front.ur: Kaun se likelihood ratios chance bohat badalte hain?

back.en: A positive LR above about 5 or a negative LR below about 0.2.
back.ur: 5 se zyada positive LR ya 0.2 se kam negative LR.

lessonTitle: Using Special Tests Wisely — Rule In, Rule Out and Clusters

front.en: Why combine tests into a cluster?
front.ur: Tests ko cluster mein kyun milate hain?

back.en: Several tests that agree move the odds much more than one test, and they cover each other's weaknesses.
back.ur: Kayi tests jo ek hi baat kahein ek test se kahin zyada chance badalte hain, aur ek doosre ki kamzori poori karte hain.

lessonTitle: The Painful Shoulder — Cuff Pain, Cuff Tears and the Tests That Tell Them Apart

front.en: What does the external rotation lag sign suggest?
front.ur: External rotation lag sign kya batata hai?

back.en: A full-thickness tear of the posterior rotator cuff.
back.ur: Posterior rotator cuff ki full-thickness tear.

lessonTitle: The Painful Shoulder — Cuff Pain, Cuff Tears and the Tests That Tell Them Apart

front.en: Which test is used for the subscapularis when the lift-off position is too painful?
front.ur: Lift-off ki position bohat dardnak ho to subscapularis ke liye kaun sa test?

back.en: The belly-press test.
back.ur: Belly-press test.

lessonTitle: The Painful Shoulder — Cuff Pain, Cuff Tears and the Tests That Tell Them Apart

front.en: What does a positive apprehension test mean?
front.ur: Positive apprehension test ka kya matlab hai?

back.en: Fear that the shoulder will come out, relieved by relocation: anterior instability.
back.ur: Shoulder ke nikalne ka dar, jo relocation se kam ho: anterior instability.

lessonTitle: The Painful Shoulder — Cuff Pain, Cuff Tears and the Tests That Tell Them Apart

front.en: Why is "impingement" a poor label?
front.ur: "Impingement" kamzor label kyun hai?

back.en: Because one positive test does not prove a particular structure is pinched; use rotator cuff-related shoulder pain.
back.ur: Kyunke ek positive test sabit nahi karta ke koi khaas structure dab raha hai; rotator cuff-related shoulder pain kahein.

lessonTitle: The Injured Knee — A Step-by-Step Ligament and Meniscus Examination

front.en: What is the best single clinical test for the ACL?
front.ur: ACL ke liye behtareen akela clinical test?

back.en: The Lachman test, at 20° to 30° of knee flexion.
back.ur: Lachman test, knee 20° se 30° flexion par.

lessonTitle: The Injured Knee — A Step-by-Step Ligament and Meniscus Examination

front.en: Laxity of the knee on valgus stress when straight means what?
front.ur: Seedhi knee par valgus stress par laxity ka kya matlab?

back.en: More than the MCL is injured (cruciate or capsule); refer.
back.ur: MCL se zyada structure zakhmi (cruciate ya capsule); refer.

lessonTitle: The Injured Knee — A Step-by-Step Ligament and Meniscus Examination

front.en: Why is early swelling after a twist important?
front.ur: Twist ke baad jaldi sujan kyun ahem hai?

back.en: It suggests bleeding into the joint: ACL tear, fracture or patellar dislocation.
back.ur: Yeh joint mein khoon ka ishara hai: ACL tear, fracture ya patellar dislocation.

lessonTitle: The Injured Knee — A Step-by-Step Ligament and Meniscus Examination

front.en: Name the five items of the Ottawa knee rule.
front.ur: Ottawa knee rule ke paanch items batayein.

back.en: Age 55 or more; tenderness of the fibular head; isolated patellar tenderness; cannot bend to 90°; cannot take four steps.
back.ur: Umar 55 ya zyada; fibular head par tenderness; patella par isolated tenderness; 90° tak na mur pana; chaar qadam na le pana.

lessonTitle: The Twisted Ankle — Ottawa Rules, Ligament Tests and the High Ankle Sprain

front.en: What do the Ottawa ankle rules decide?
front.ur: Ottawa ankle rules kis cheez ka faisla karte hain?

back.en: Whether an ankle or foot X-ray is needed after an acute injury.
back.ur: Acute chot ke baad ankle ya foot X-ray ki zaroorat hai ya nahi.

lessonTitle: The Twisted Ankle — Ottawa Rules, Ligament Tests and the High Ankle Sprain

front.en: Which ligament does the anterior drawer test?
front.ur: Anterior drawer kaun sa ligament test karta hai?

back.en: The anterior talofibular ligament (ATFL).
back.ur: Anterior talofibular ligament (ATFL).

lessonTitle: The Twisted Ankle — Ottawa Rules, Ligament Tests and the High Ankle Sprain

front.en: Where must the pain be felt in the squeeze test?
front.ur: Squeeze test mein dard kahan hona chahiye?

back.en: At the ankle between the tibia and fibula, not at the squeeze site.
back.ur: Ankle par tibia aur fibula ke beech, dabane ki jagah par nahi.

lessonTitle: The Twisted Ankle — Ottawa Rules, Ligament Tests and the High Ankle Sprain

front.en: When are ankle ligament tests most accurate?
front.ur: Ankle ligament tests kab zyada durust hote hain?

back.en: Four to five days after the injury.
back.ur: Chot ke chaar paanch din baad.

lessonTitle: Hip and Groin Pain — What to Test, What to Rule Out

front.en: What does the C sign suggest?
front.ur: C sign kis ki taraf ishara karta hai?

back.en: Pain from the hip joint itself.
back.ur: Hip joint ka apna dard.

lessonTitle: Hip and Groin Pain — What to Test, What to Rule Out

front.en: What does a negative FADIR make unlikely?
front.ur: Negative FADIR kis ko kam mumkin banata hai?

back.en: Femoroacetabular impingement and a labral tear.
back.ur: Femoroacetabular impingement aur labral tear.

lessonTitle: Hip and Groin Pain — What to Test, What to Rule Out

front.en: Which teenage problem can look like knee pain?
front.ur: Kaun si teenage problem knee ke dard jaisi lag sakti hai?

back.en: A slipped capital femoral epiphysis of the hip.
back.ur: Hip ka slipped capital femoral epiphysis.

lessonTitle: Hip and Groin Pain — What to Test, What to Rule Out

front.en: Where should you also examine in hip pain?
front.ur: Hip ke dard mein aur kahan examine karna chahiye?

back.en: The lumbar spine and the knee.
back.ur: Lumbar spine aur knee.

lessonTitle: Numb Hands — Carpal Tunnel, Cubital Tunnel and the Neck

front.en: Which fingers does the median nerve supply sensation to?
front.ur: Median nerve kin ungliyon ko hiss deta hai?

back.en: Thumb, index, middle and half of the ring finger.
back.ur: Anguthha, shahadat, beech ki aur ring finger ka aadha hissa.

lessonTitle: Numb Hands — Carpal Tunnel, Cubital Tunnel and the Neck

front.en: What does thenar wasting suggest?
front.ur: Thenar sukharna kis ki taraf ishara karta hai?

back.en: A long-standing or severe median nerve compression.
back.ur: Median nerve ka purana ya shadeed dabao.

lessonTitle: Numb Hands — Carpal Tunnel, Cubital Tunnel and the Neck

front.en: Why is a neutral night splint useful?
front.ur: Neutral night splint kyun mufeed hai?

back.en: It keeps the wrist from bending, so the tunnel stays open during sleep.
back.ur: Yeh kalai ko mudne se rokta hai, is liye neend mein tunnel khula rehta hai.

lessonTitle: Numb Hands — Carpal Tunnel, Cubital Tunnel and the Neck

front.en: Which fingers suggest the ulnar nerve?
front.ur: Kaun si ungliyan ulnar nerve ki taraf ishara karti hain?

back.en: The little finger and half of the ring finger.
back.ur: Chhoti ungli aur ring finger ka aadha hissa.

lessonTitle: The Six-Minute Walk Test — Measuring Breathlessness Safely

front.en: What does the six-minute walk test measure?
front.ur: Chhe minute walk test kya naapta hai?

back.en: How far a patient can walk in six minutes at their own pace.
back.ur: Patient apni raftar se chhe minute mein kitna door chal sakta hai.

lessonTitle: The Six-Minute Walk Test — Measuring Breathlessness Safely

front.en: Why must the test be standardised?
front.ur: Test standardise kyun hona chahiye?

back.en: So a change in distance reflects the patient, not the way the test was done.
back.ur: Taake distance ki tabdeeli patient ko dikhaye, test ke tareeqe ko nahi.

lessonTitle: The Six-Minute Walk Test — Measuring Breathlessness Safely

front.en: What does the Borg scale record?
front.ur: Borg scale kya likhta hai?

back.en: How hard the patient feels breathing is.
back.ur: Patient ko saans lena kitna mushkil lagta hai.

lessonTitle: The Six-Minute Walk Test — Measuring Breathlessness Safely

front.en: Name one reason to stop the test.
front.ur: Test rokne ki ek wajah batayein.

back.en: Chest pain, severe breathlessness, dizziness or a pale, sweaty patient.
back.ur: Seene ka dard, shadeed saans ki tangi, chakkar ya zard paseene mein dooba patient.

lessonTitle: Think Like an Expert — Hypotheses, Red Flags and Thinking Errors

front.en: What is anchoring?
front.ur: Anchoring kya hai?

back.en: Holding on to the first idea and ignoring facts that do not fit.
back.ur: Pehli soch se chipak jana aur jo haqaiq mel na khayen unhein nazar andaz karna.

lessonTitle: Think Like an Expert — Hypotheses, Red Flags and Thinking Errors

front.en: What is confirmation bias?
front.ur: Confirmation bias kya hai?

back.en: Looking only for what supports your idea.
back.ur: Sirf wohi dhoondna jo apni soch ki himayat kare.

lessonTitle: Think Like an Expert — Hypotheses, Red Flags and Thinking Errors

front.en: What question guards against premature closure?
front.ur: Premature closure se kaun sa sawal bachata hai?

back.en: "What else could this be, and what would prove me wrong?"
back.ur: "Aur kya ho sakta hai, aur mujhe kya ghalat sabit karega?"

lessonTitle: Think Like an Expert — Hypotheses, Red Flags and Thinking Errors

front.en: How should red flags be judged?
front.ur: Red flags ko kaise parkha jaye?

back.en: Together, as a cluster, with the history and findings.
back.ur: Milakar, imtizaaj ki tarah, history aur findings ke saath.

lessonTitle: The Pelvic Floor — Leaks, Pregnancy and Life After Childbirth

front.en: What is stress urinary incontinence?
front.ur: Stress urinary incontinence kya hai?

back.en: Leaking urine when pressure rises, for example with a cough, laugh or lift.
back.ur: Peshab ka nikalna jab dabao barhe, maslan khansi, hansi ya wazan par.

lessonTitle: The Pelvic Floor — Leaks, Pregnancy and Life After Childbirth

front.en: What are the two halves of a good pelvic floor contraction?
front.ur: Achhi pelvic floor contraction ke do hisse kya hain?

back.en: A gentle lift and a full release.
back.ur: Halka oopar khainchna aur poori tarah chhorna.

lessonTitle: The Pelvic Floor — Leaks, Pregnancy and Life After Childbirth

front.en: What is "the knack"?
front.ur: "Knack" kya hai?

back.en: Squeezing the pelvic floor just before a cough or lift.
back.ur: Khansi ya wazan se pehle pelvic floor dabana.

lessonTitle: The Pelvic Floor — Leaks, Pregnancy and Life After Childbirth

front.en: How long should a programme run before judging it?
front.ur: Programme ko parakhne se pehle kitni der chalana chahiye?

back.en: At least three months.
back.ur: Kam az kam teen mahine.

lessonTitle: Back and Pelvic Pain in Pregnancy — Examine, Reassure and Support

front.en: Where is pelvic girdle pain felt?
front.ur: Pelvic girdle pain kahan hota hai?

back.en: Between the back of the pelvis and the buttock, and sometimes at the pubic bone.
back.ur: Pelvis ke peechay aur kulhay ke beech, aur kabhi pubic haddi par.

lessonTitle: Back and Pelvic Pain in Pregnancy — Examine, Reassure and Support

front.en: Name a test for pelvic girdle pain.
front.ur: Pelvic girdle pain ke ek test ka naam batayein.

back.en: The posterior pelvic pain provocation (thigh thrust) test.
back.ur: Posterior pelvic pain provocation (thigh thrust) test.

lessonTitle: Back and Pelvic Pain in Pregnancy — Examine, Reassure and Support

front.en: Where is a pelvic belt worn?
front.ur: Pelvic belt kahan pehna jata hai?

back.en: Low over the hips and pubic bone, not at the waist.
back.ur: Kulhon aur pubic haddi par neeche, kamar par nahi.

lessonTitle: Back and Pelvic Pain in Pregnancy — Examine, Reassure and Support

front.en: What is the usual course of pelvic girdle pain?
front.ur: Pelvic girdle pain ka aam silsila kya hai?

back.en: It improves after birth in most women.
back.ur: Zyada tar khawateen mein paidaish ke baad behtar ho jata hai.

lessonTitle: Preventing Falls in Older Adults — Screen, Strengthen, Balance

front.en: What two questions screen for fall risk?
front.ur: Girne ke khatre ki screening ke do sawal kaun se hain?

back.en: A fall in the past year and feeling unsteady on standing or walking.
back.ur: Pichle saal girna aur khare hone ya chalne mein ladkharahat.

lessonTitle: Preventing Falls in Older Adults — Screen, Strengthen, Balance

front.en: What is the Otago programme?
front.ur: Otago programme kya hai?

back.en: A home programme of leg strengthening and balance exercises plus walking, taught by a trained therapist.
back.ur: Taangon ki strengthening, balance exercises aur chalne ka ghar ka programme jo trained therapist sikhata hai.

lessonTitle: Preventing Falls in Older Adults — Screen, Strengthen, Balance

front.en: How often should fall-prevention exercise be done?
front.ur: Girne se bachao ki exercise kitni baar karni chahiye?

back.en: At least three times a week.
back.ur: Haftay mein kam az kam teen baar.

lessonTitle: Preventing Falls in Older Adults — Screen, Strengthen, Balance

front.en: Name two home changes that reduce falls.
front.ur: Ghar mein do tabdeeliyan batayein jo girna kam karti hain.

back.en: Remove loose rugs and improve lighting (also grab rails and suitable shoes).
back.ur: Dheelay qaleen hatana aur roshni behtar karna (saath rails aur munasib joote).

lessonTitle: Osteoporosis — Exercising Safely to Protect Bones

front.en: Why do bones respond to exercise?
front.ur: Haddiyan exercise par kyun react karti hain?

back.en: Regular loading signals bone to build and reorganise tissue.
back.ur: Baqaida loading haddi ko tissue banane aur dobara tarteeb dene ka ishara deti hai.

lessonTitle: Osteoporosis — Exercising Safely to Protect Bones

front.en: Which movement is avoided after a vertebral fracture?
front.ur: Vertebral fracture ke baad kaun si harkat se bachte hain?

back.en: Loaded forward bending, such as sit-ups or lifting with a rounded back.
back.ur: Loaded aage jhukna, maslan sit-ups ya gol peeth se uthana.

lessonTitle: Osteoporosis — Exercising Safely to Protect Bones

front.en: Name the three jobs of osteoporosis exercise.
front.ur: Osteoporosis exercise ke teen kaam batayein.

back.en: Load the bone, strengthen muscle and train balance.
back.ur: Haddi par load, muscle ki taaqat aur balance ki training.

lessonTitle: Osteoporosis — Exercising Safely to Protect Bones

front.en: What is the safe way to bend and lift?
front.ur: Jhukne aur uthane ka mehfooz tareeqa kya hai?

back.en: A hip hinge with a neutral spine.
back.ur: Neutral spine ke saath hip hinge.

lessonTitle: After a Total Knee Replacement — Early Movement, Strength and Safety

front.en: What are the early range goals after a knee replacement?
front.ur: Knee replacement ke baad shuruati range ke maqasid kya hain?

back.en: Full extension and at least 90 degrees of bend by about two weeks.
back.ur: Poori extension aur takreeban do haftay mein kam az kam 90 degree mudna.

lessonTitle: After a Total Knee Replacement — Early Movement, Strength and Safety

front.en: Which muscle is most important to rebuild?
front.ur: Kaun sa muscle dobara banana sab se ahem hai?

back.en: The quadriceps.
back.ur: Quadriceps.

lessonTitle: After a Total Knee Replacement — Early Movement, Strength and Safety

front.en: Name two signs of infection.
front.ur: Infection ki do nishaniyan batayein.

back.en: A hot, red, swollen knee with fever, or a leaking wound.
back.ur: Bukhar ke saath garam, surkh, soojha hua knee, ya zakhm se pani nikalna.

lessonTitle: After a Total Knee Replacement — Early Movement, Strength and Safety

front.en: Why is early stiffness a problem?
front.ur: Shuruati akhrapan masla kyun hai?

back.en: Scar tissue matures and the lost range is hard to regain later.
back.ur: Scar tissue pukhta ho jata hai aur khoyi hui range baad mein wapas laana mushkil hai.

lessonTitle: After a Total Hip Replacement — Precautions, Walking and Strength

front.en: Who decides the hip precautions?
front.ur: Hip ehtiyatein kaun tay karta hai?

back.en: The surgeon, based on the approach and the patient.
back.ur: Surgeon, approach aur mareez ki bunyad par.

lessonTitle: After a Total Hip Replacement — Precautions, Walking and Strength

front.en: Name three posterior-approach precautions.
front.ur: Posterior approach ki teen ehtiyatein batayein.

back.en: Avoid bending the hip far past a right angle, crossing the legs and turning the knee inwards.
back.ur: Hip ko seedhe zaviye se bohat zyada na modein, taangein cross na karein aur knee ko andar na ghumayein.

lessonTitle: After a Total Hip Replacement — Precautions, Walking and Strength

front.en: What is a sign of dislocation?
front.ur: Dislocation ki nishani kya hai?

back.en: Sudden severe pain with a short, turned leg and inability to bear weight.
back.ur: Achanak shadeed dard, chhoti mudi hui taang aur wazan na utha pana.

lessonTitle: After a Total Hip Replacement — Precautions, Walking and Strength

front.en: What should you do for a hot, swollen, tender calf?
front.ur: Garam, soojhi hui, dardnak pindli par kya karein?

back.en: Stop exercise and get urgent assessment for a clot.
back.ur: Exercise rokein aur clot ke liye foran assessment karwayein.

lessonTitle: Return to Sport After ACL Surgery — Criteria, Not the Calendar

front.en: What are the three steps of return to sport?
front.ur: Return to sport ke teen marhale kaun se hain?

back.en: Return to participation, return to sport and return to performance.
back.ur: Hissa lena, khel aur performance par wapsi.

lessonTitle: Return to Sport After ACL Surgery — Criteria, Not the Calendar

front.en: What limb symmetry target is common?
front.ur: Limb symmetry ka aam maqsad kya hai?

back.en: At least 90 percent in strength and hop tests.
back.ur: Strength aur hop tests mein kam az kam 90 percent.

lessonTitle: Return to Sport After ACL Surgery — Criteria, Not the Calendar

front.en: Why not return at a set date?
front.ur: Muqarrar tareekh par wapsi kyun nahi?

back.en: Readiness varies; criteria predict risk better than time alone.
back.ur: Taiyari mukhtalif hoti hai; mayaar khatre ki behtar peshgoi karte hain.

lessonTitle: Return to Sport After ACL Surgery — Criteria, Not the Calendar

front.en: Which tool measures confidence after ACL surgery?
front.ur: ACL surgery ke baad aitemad kaun sa tool naapta hai?

back.en: The ACL-RSI.
back.ur: ACL-RSI.

lessonTitle: Training Load and Injury Risk — Building Athletes, Not Breaking Them

front.en: What is training load?
front.ur: Training load kya hai?

back.en: The amount of work the body does, often time multiplied by how hard it felt.
back.ur: Jism ka kiya hua kaam, aksar waqt ko is se zarb ke woh kitna sakht laga.

lessonTitle: Training Load and Injury Risk — Building Athletes, Not Breaking Them

front.en: What raises injury risk?
front.ur: Chot ka khatra kya barhata hai?

back.en: A sudden large rise in load compared with what the body is used to.
back.ur: Load mein achanak bara izafa jis ka jism aadi nahi.

lessonTitle: Training Load and Injury Risk — Building Athletes, Not Breaking Them

front.en: What can protect against injury?
front.ur: Chot se kya bacha sakta hai?

back.en: A steady, high chronic load built gradually.
back.ur: Aahista banaya gaya musalsal, zyada chronic load.

lessonTitle: Training Load and Injury Risk — Building Athletes, Not Breaking Them

front.en: What is the 10 percent rule?
front.ur: 10 percent rule kya hai?

back.en: A rough guide for weekly increases, not an exact rule.
back.ur: Haftay ke izafe ki aam rehnumai, durust usool nahi.

lessonTitle: Reading a Randomised Trial — Bias, Confidence Intervals and What to Trust

front.en: What does randomisation do?
front.ur: Randomisation kya karti hai?

back.en: Makes groups alike by chance, apart from the treatment.
back.ur: Groups ko ilaj ke ilawa ittefaq se ek jaisa banati hai.

lessonTitle: Reading a Randomised Trial — Bias, Confidence Intervals and What to Trust

front.en: What does a 95 percent confidence interval show?
front.ur: 95 percent confidence interval kya dikhata hai?

back.en: The range of effect sizes compatible with the data.
back.ur: Asar ke woh sizes jo data ke mutabiq hain.

lessonTitle: Reading a Randomised Trial — Bias, Confidence Intervals and What to Trust

front.en: What is the difference between statistical and clinical importance?
front.ur: Statistical aur clinical ahmiyat mein kya farq hai?

back.en: Statistical means unlikely by chance; clinical means large enough to matter to patients.
back.ur: Statistical ka matlab ittefaq se kam mumkin; clinical ka matlab mareezon ke liye ahem hone ke qabil bara.

lessonTitle: Reading a Randomised Trial — Bias, Confidence Intervals and What to Trust

front.en: What does blinding protect against?
front.ur: Blinding kis se bachati hai?

back.en: Expectations changing care or measurement.
back.ur: Tawaqqaat ka care ya paimaish badalna.

lessonTitle: Outcome Measures — Is the Change Real and Does It Matter?

front.en: What is the minimal important change?
front.ur: Minimal important change kya hai?

back.en: The smallest change a patient would consider worthwhile.
back.ur: Chhoti tareen tabdeeli jise mareez qabil-e-qadar samjhe.

lessonTitle: Outcome Measures — Is the Change Real and Does It Matter?

front.en: What is measurement error?
front.ur: Measurement error kya hai?

back.en: The random variation in a score when nothing has really changed.
back.ur: Score mein random tabdeeli jab asal mein kuch na badla ho.

lessonTitle: Outcome Measures — Is the Change Real and Does It Matter?

front.en: What is a typical important change in pain on a 0 to 10 scale?
front.ur: 0 se 10 ke scale par dard mein aam ahem tabdeeli kya hai?

back.en: About 2 points or 30 percent.
back.ur: Takreeban 2 points ya 30 percent.

lessonTitle: Outcome Measures — Is the Change Real and Does It Matter?

front.en: Why repeat the same tool?
front.ur: Wohi tool kyun dohrayein?

back.en: So scores are comparable over time.
back.ur: Taake scores waqt ke saath muqable ke qabil hon.

lessonTitle: Cardiac Rehabilitation — Exercising Safely After a Heart Event

front.en: Name the three phases of cardiac rehabilitation.
front.ur: Cardiac rehabilitation ke teen marahil batayein.

back.en: Early (hospital), supervised outpatient and long-term maintenance.
back.ur: Shuruati (hospital), nigrani wala outpatient aur taweel muddat ki maintenance.

lessonTitle: Cardiac Rehabilitation — Exercising Safely After a Heart Event

front.en: What Borg effort level is usual?
front.ur: Aam Borg effort kya hai?

back.en: About 11 to 14 on the 6 to 20 scale.
back.ur: 6 se 20 scale par takreeban 11 se 14.

lessonTitle: Cardiac Rehabilitation — Exercising Safely After a Heart Event

front.en: Why is a formula heart rate unreliable?
front.ur: Formula heart rate bharosemand kyun nahi?

back.en: Medicines such as beta-blockers change the heart rate response.
back.ur: Beta-blockers jaisi dawaiyan heart rate ka jawab badal deti hain.

lessonTitle: Cardiac Rehabilitation — Exercising Safely After a Heart Event

front.en: Name two reasons to stop a session.
front.ur: Session rokne ki do wajuhat batayein.

back.en: Chest pain, severe breathlessness, dizziness or a fall in blood pressure.
back.ur: Seene ka dard, shadeed saans ki tangi, chakkar ya blood pressure mein kami.

lessonTitle: Heat and Cold — What They Really Do and When to Avoid Them

front.en: When is heat useful?
front.ur: Garmi kab mufeed hai?

back.en: For stiff, tight tissue without swelling or inflammation.
back.ur: Akhre, tight tissue ke liye bina sujan ya sozish ke.

lessonTitle: Heat and Cold — What They Really Do and When to Avoid Them

front.en: How long is a typical heat or cold application?
front.ur: Garmi ya sardi ka aam waqt kitna hai?

back.en: About 15 to 20 minutes for heat and 10 to 15 for cold.
back.ur: Garmi ke liye takreeban 15 se 20 minute aur sardi ke liye 10 se 15.

lessonTitle: Heat and Cold — What They Really Do and When to Avoid Them

front.en: What does PEACE stand for?
front.ur: PEACE ka matlab kya hai?

back.en: Protect, Elevate, Avoid anti-inflammatories, Compress, Educate.
back.ur: Protect, Elevate, Avoid anti-inflammatories, Compress, Educate.

lessonTitle: Heat and Cold — What They Really Do and When to Avoid Them

front.en: Who needs extra care with heat and cold?
front.ur: Garmi aur sardi mein kis ko ziyada ehtiyat chahiye?

back.en: People with poor sensation or circulation, such as in diabetes.
back.ur: Kamzor hiss ya circulation wale log, maslan diabetes mein.

lessonTitle: Passing the OSCE and Viva — A Method, Not Luck

front.en: What is an OSCE?
front.ur: OSCE kya hai?

back.en: An objective structured clinical examination of short, marked stations.
back.ur: Chhote, marks hone wale stations ka objective structured clinical examination.

lessonTitle: Passing the OSCE and Viva — A Method, Not Luck

front.en: Name the five parts of the routine.
front.ur: Routine ke paanch hissay batayein.

back.en: Introduce, consent, expose, examine, explain.
back.ur: Taaruf, razamandi, expose, examine, wazahat.

lessonTitle: Passing the OSCE and Viva — A Method, Not Luck

front.en: What should you do if you forget a step?
front.ur: Koi qadam bhool jayein to kya karein?

back.en: Say so, do it now and continue.
back.ur: Batayein, abhi karein aur jaari rakhein.

lessonTitle: Passing the OSCE and Viva — A Method, Not Luck

front.en: How should you practise?
front.ur: Mashq kaise karein?

back.en: Aloud, with a partner, a stopwatch and a checklist.
back.ur: Bol kar, partner, stopwatch aur checklist ke saath.

lessonTitle: Writing Clear Clinical Notes — SOAP, Consent and Safe Records

front.en: What do the four letters of SOAP stand for?
front.ur: SOAP ke chaar harf kya hain?

back.en: Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan.
back.ur: Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan.

lessonTitle: Writing Clear Clinical Notes — SOAP, Consent and Safe Records

front.en: Which part holds measurements?
front.ur: Kaun sa hissa paimaish rakhta hai?

back.en: Objective.
back.ur: Objective.

lessonTitle: Writing Clear Clinical Notes — SOAP, Consent and Safe Records

front.en: How do you correct an old entry?
front.ur: Purani entry kaise theek karein?

back.en: Add a dated correction; never delete or change the original.
back.ur: Tareekh ke saath tasheeh shamil karein; asal ko kabhi na mitayein.

lessonTitle: Writing Clear Clinical Notes — SOAP, Consent and Safe Records

front.en: Why record consent?
front.ur: Razamandi kyun likhein?

back.en: It shows the patient understood and agreed to the plan.
back.ur: Yeh dikhata hai ke mareez ne plan samjha aur manzoor kiya.

lessonTitle: Flat Feet, In-Toeing and Bow Legs in Children — When to Reassure and When to Refer

front.en: What makes a flat foot flexible?
front.ur: Flat foot lachakdar kab hota hai?

back.en: The arch appears when the child rises onto the toes.
back.ur: Ungliyon par uthne par arch nazar aata hai.

lessonTitle: Flat Feet, In-Toeing and Bow Legs in Children — When to Reassure and When to Refer

front.en: When does in-toeing usually improve?
front.ur: In-toeing kab behtar hoti hai?

back.en: By itself, usually by age eight to ten.
back.ur: Khud, aam taur par aath se das saal tak.

lessonTitle: Flat Feet, In-Toeing and Bow Legs in Children — When to Reassure and When to Refer

front.en: Name two signs that need referral.
front.ur: Referral ki do nishaniyan batayein.

back.en: Pain, a limp, stiffness, or one-sided findings.
back.ur: Dard, langar, akhrapan, ya ek taraf ki findings.

lessonTitle: Flat Feet, In-Toeing and Bow Legs in Children — When to Reassure and When to Refer

front.en: Do insoles change a flexible flat foot?
front.ur: Kya insoles flexible flat foot badalte hain?

back.en: Evidence does not show that they do.
back.ur: Evidence nahi dikhata ke badalte hain.

lessonTitle: Breathlessness — Positions, Pacing and Breathing Control

front.en: What is pursed-lip breathing?
front.ur: Pursed-lip breathing kya hai?

back.en: Breathing in through the nose and slowly out through pursed lips.
back.ur: Naak se andar aur pursed hontoon se aahista bahar saans lena.

lessonTitle: Breathlessness — Positions, Pacing and Breathing Control

front.en: Name a recovery position.
front.ur: Recovery position ka naam batayein.

back.en: Leaning forward with the forearms supported on a table or knees.
back.ur: Aage jhukna, bazu mez ya ghutnon par tike hue.

lessonTitle: Breathlessness — Positions, Pacing and Breathing Control

front.en: Why use a hand-held fan?
front.ur: Hath ka pankha kyun?

back.en: Air on the face can reduce the sensation of breathlessness.
back.ur: Chehre par hawa saans ki tangi ka ehsaas kam kar sakti hai.

lessonTitle: Breathlessness — Positions, Pacing and Breathing Control

front.en: When is breathlessness an emergency?
front.ur: Saans ki tangi emergency kab hai?

back.en: At rest with blue lips, chest pain, confusion or drowsiness.
back.ur: Aaram mein neelay honth, seene ka dard, uljhan ya neend ke saath.

lessonTitle: Returning to Exercise After Childbirth — Gradual, Safe and Individual

front.en: What decides return to running after birth?
front.ur: Paidaish ke baad daurna kab shuru ho yeh kya tay karta hai?

back.en: Readiness: no leaking, heaviness or pain, with good strength.
back.ur: Taiyari: leaking, bojh ya dard nahi, achhi taaqat ke saath.

lessonTitle: Returning to Exercise After Childbirth — Gradual, Safe and Individual

front.en: Is an abdominal gap always a problem?
front.ur: Kya pait ka gap hamesha masla hai?

back.en: No, it is common and often narrows; function matters more.
back.ur: Nahi, aam hai aur aksar kam ho jata hai; function zyada ahem hai.
